title: Prism Paths 光路迷阵
description: A laser refraction puzzle on an obsidian board! Rotate mirrors, split beams with prisms, thread through color filters, and bounce off one-shot ice mirrors to light every matching crystal. Purple crystals demand two different colors arriving at once. 30 hand-crafted levels across three chapters — Reflection Basics, Splitting & Filters, and Master Challenges — with par-based star ratings and chapter unlock gates. Pure logic, zero luck: every beam is deterministic.
controls: Click / tap any mirror or prism to rotate it 90°. Guide every emitter's beam into its matching color crystal (purple crystals need two distinct colors). Z undoes, R resets the level, P pauses, M mutes.
author: LightGame
